decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Monastery Swiftspear while maintaining card advantage with cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble. The deck relies on efficient spells like Lava Dart and Lightning Bolt to clear the way for its creatures, and utilizes Mutagenic Growth and Violent Urge to pump them up for additional damage. The mana base is optimized for consistent color access, and Slickshot Show-Off provides additional reach in the late game. Overall, the deck aims to win the game quickly through aggressive creature attacks and burn spells.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying artifacts to generate mana and card advantage, while utilizing efficient removal and combat tricks to control the board and push damage through to the opponent. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provide card advantage and recursion while Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal enable explosive starts. Urza's Saga generates threats and tutors for key artifacts, while Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt offer reach and removal. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and resilience, leveraging the power of artifacts in the process.

This deck focuses on quickly flooding the board with aggressive creatures like Ragavan and Territorial Kavu, while using Leyline of the Guildpact to boost their power. The deck also utilizes powerful spells like Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt for direct damage to the opponent. Leyline Binding and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide control options, while Phlage and Scion of Draco offer late-game finishers. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure smooth casting of spells and the inclusion of Leyline of the Guildpact to maximize efficiency.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and discard spells. The deck aims to maintain card advantage and board control while overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares. Utilizing a mix of control elements and threats, this Dimir Control deck seeks to dominate the game through efficient removal and disruption, ultimately allowing the player to outvalue the opponent and secure victory.

This aggro deck focuses on using a combination of multicolored spells and creatures to quickly overwhelm opponents with efficient threats. Tribal Flames and Leyline of the Guildpact provide additional reach and support for the aggressive game plan, while creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco offer both early pressure and late-game resilience. Stubborn Denial and Leyline Binding help to protect key threats and disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to support its diverse color requirements and maximize consistency.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. Utilizing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, along with burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional aggression and combo potential with Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The deck also includes disruption elements like Static Prison and Thraben Charm to control the board. Overall, the focus is on fast creature-based aggression with some burn and disruption elements to support the game plan.

The deck revolves around using Eldrazi creatures and synergistic cards to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggro strategies. By utilizing cards like Kozilek's Command and Thought-Knot Seer, along with Eldrazi Temple and Cavern of Souls for mana acceleration, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain board control throughout the game. With a mix of powerful creatures like Sire of Seven Deaths and disruptive spells like Chalice of the Void, the deck looks to secure victories through efficient aggression and strategic plays.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw. It aims to maintain board control while disrupting the opponent's strategies through a combination of spells and powerful creatures. The selection of cards allows for a versatile and adaptable playstyle, with options for both offensive and defensive strategies. The deck's mana base is designed to support a variety of spells across different colors, ensuring consistent access to the necessary resources to dominate the game.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with the ability to repeatedly blink creatures for value. By utilizing cards like Flickerwisp, Ephemerate, and Dreams of Steel and Oil, players can constantly bounce and re-enter powerful threats like Overlord of the Balemurk and Godless Shrine. This disruptive strategy can quickly overwhelm opponents by generating incremental advantage and disrupting their game plan. Additionally, cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push provide additional disruption, ensuring the deck can maintain control of the game while pressuring the opponent.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using artifacts and creatures without relying on lands for mana. By balancing counterspells, disruptive spells, and combo pieces, the deck aims to control the game until it can assemble the necessary pieces to win the game quickly. The combination of card advantage, protection, and mana acceleration allows the deck to consistently execute its game plan, overwhelming opponents with a synergistic strategy that leverages unique interactions and powerful abilities.

The main idea of this deck is to assemble a powerful combo using Broodscale Bloodchief along with other key cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Kozilek's Command. The deck focuses on creating a strong board presence and controlling the game with cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Malevolent Rumble. By utilizing mana acceleration and card advantage, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through synergistic interactions between its creatures and spells. The inclusion of specific lands and artifacts also enhances the overall strategy of the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively play creatures and control the board with removal spells and enchantments. The key strategy revolves around utilizing Leyline of the Guildpact to pump up your creatures and Leyline Binding to control your opponent's threats. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu are your primary threats, while Scion of Draco and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide additional firepower. The deck also includes a mix of lands to ramp up mana production and fix colors, as well as cards like Stubborn Denial for protection and Tribal Flames for additional reach.

The main strategy of this deck is to control the game through counterspells and removal spells, while utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Jace, the Mind Sculptor to gain card advantage and maintain board control. The deck also includes cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Terminus to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistency and stability in casting spells, while the inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion adds an extra layer of synergy to the deck.

The main goal of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. It aims to control the battlefield with cards like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison while also dealing direct damage with Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Voice of Victory provide additional support for the aggressive strategy, allowing the deck to quickly close out games with the combination of creatures and burn spells. By maintaining pressure and controlling the board, this deck aims to win quickly and decisively.

This deck focuses on using cycling creatures to fill up the graveyard, then using Living End to bring them back onto the battlefield all at once. The key strategy is to cycle through your deck quickly to set up a big Living End play, while also disrupting your opponent with counterspells and removal. The deck also includes cards like Subtlety and Endurance to provide additional utility and protection. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm your opponent with a powerful board presence while controlling the game with disruptive spells.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent by playing low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, supported by efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart. The deck also includes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to maintain card advantage and pump up Dragon's Rage Channeler. The goal is to win the game as fast as possible through aggressive creature attacks and direct damage spells, while also having some flexibility with cards like Prismatic Ending for removal.
